title: Add defmt logfmt conventions to lichen-node
description: In lichen-node runtime_receive() and runtime_poll(), add defmt::debug! with logfmt-style format strings: defmt::debug!("pkt_id={} event=rx_frame len={}", pkt_id, len). Use conditional compilation (#[cfg(feature = "defmt")]) for embedded, log::debug! for std. Verify: cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-node
